2026-12-01.title: God’s Masterpiece
2026-12-01.verse: Certainly you made my mind and heart; you wove me together in my mother’s womb. I will give you thanks because your deeds are awesome and amazing. You knew me thoroughly.
2026-12-01.observation: Before my wife and I had our first child, I was terribly afraid I was not going to like being a dad. I had never been around children and did not know what to do. When I saw people with their babies, it seemed like a lot of work and not much reward. Then, we had our first child. Instantly, I realized why I was put on this Earth. I am here to love God, to show people who He is, and to be a dad. I love my girls. They are God’s beautiful creation. And not just them; all people are made by God and are beautiful to Him. This is why the sin of abortion is so devastating. Whenever someone chooses to end a baby’s life, they are destroying God’s beautiful creation. When we see others, we see just another person. When God sees them, He sees His beautiful creation. When God sees you, He sees someone worth dying for and worth saving from sin. Have you ever thought about how God sees you?
2026-12-01.application: Take a moment and think about the fact that God loved you so much, He came to die on a Cross for you.
2026-12-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us so much.

2026-12-02.title: Ask God For Help
2026-12-02.verse: O LORD, rescue me from wicked men. Protect me from violent men, who plan ways to harm me. All day long they stir up conflict.
2026-12-02.observation: One day, when my girls were little, one of them came home and told me all about some conflict going on in her classroom. Two classmates were not getting along, and one of them was unwilling to play with the other on the playground. She ended by asking me what I was going to do about it. I was flattered that she immediately thought her dad could fix this, but I also had no idea what to do. I started giving her ideas on how she could fix it and also told her she should tell her teacher. I’m glad the Lord is not like that. He doesn’t hear our issues and then tell us to go talk to someone else because He can’t do anything about it. God has never once told us there was nothing He could do. When we go through hard times, prayer should be our first response and not our last resort. No matter what we struggle with, He is aware, He cares, and He wants to lead us to peace.
2026-12-02.application: Take a moment today and unload all your worries and cares onto the Lord. He cares for you.
2026-12-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to listen to us.

2026-12-13.title: We Never Travel Alone
2026-12-13.verse: And in this regard we pray for you always, that our God will make you worthy of his calling and fulfill by his power your every desire for goodness and every work of faith,
2026-12-13.observation: When we go to the store to buy groceries, we pick out our items, go pay, then go home. Many think that salvation is like this. We come to church with a need, we receive salvation, then go home. The thought is that “all” we took with us was salvation. This is not how the “with God” life works. We are now “with God” in our lives. We are never alone again. (We were never alone to begin with. However, now we know Him and are aware of His closeness.) God not only sets the path of our lives, but gives us the power to walk in it. He goes with us all along the way. He is our traveling companion.
2026-12-13.application: Realize you will not encounter anything today alone. God is with you and will give you the strength to do everything He has called you to do.
2026-12-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us more than we could ever realize.

2026-12-14.title: The Journey of Holiness Begins with Truth
2026-12-14.verse: But we ought to thank God always for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and faith in the truth.
2026-12-14.observation: What we believe is wildly important. One of my mentors, Dr. Norman Geisler, said that our culture is more impacted by Immanuel Kant than Jesus Christ. This is because it was Kant who popularized the notions that we now call Relativism. This is the notion that we can never know truth because all truth is subjective to our experience. So, we cannot perceive truth in its rawest form because we cannot get rid of our presuppositions. This is not so. God’s Word says we can know the truth and that truth has the power to set us free. The verse today says we can be made holy through the Spirit as we believe the truth. Though we may have different experiences with the truth, we can still know what it is. I may use a hammer differently than my neighbor, but we both know what it is and its basic functions. So, don’t fall to the trap of relativism today. Realize the truth is knowable. Seek it out. Study God’s Word. Watch it set you free by the power of the Holy Spirit.
2026-12-14.application: Live by God’s Word as the Universal Truth of all things.
2026-12-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the capacity to know truth.

2026-12-16.title: Where Is God Leading Us?
2026-12-16.verse: Now may the Lord direct your hearts toward the love of God and the endurance of Christ.
2026-12-16.observation: With modern technology, it’s possible to see where someone is going by using your phone to pull up GPS. What’s more convenient is most modern cars have the GPS either built in or connects to your phone. This way, you can see where someone is going as they are guided by GPS. Because of this, I can’t stand riding with someone and having no idea where we are going. This is also probably because I like to drive. Many times we can feel this way about life. Where are we going? Why did life turn this way or that way? If God is in control of my life, did He miss a turn somewhere? Where is He heading? God’s Word says He is leading us into a full understanding and expression of His love. He is also leading us to have patient endurance that comes from communion with Christ. This is beautiful. So, whenever we encounter anything today we realize God hasn’t taken a wrong turn. He is leading us toward knowing Him more.
2026-12-16.application: Trust all the turns God makes today.
2026-12-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us so well.
